title: Coordinate acceptance lanes and signoff criteria for Private multi-region fallback and rollback
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Private deployments in multiple cloud regions require a clear, fast decision path for falling back to alternate regions or rolling back to a previous private control plane when we detect regulatory, latency, or capacity failures. Current PRD drafts have ambiguous acceptance gates for cross-border legal checks and no agreed-on telemetry thresholds that should trigger an automated fallback vs. manual rollback. This ticket coordinates a cross-team acceptance matrix, defines concrete rollback triggers and guardrails, and collects legal/SSO/audit signoffs for the PRD.

Goal: Produce a signed PRD annex and an acceptance checklist that engineering, design, and legal can all sign against. The annex must include: precise telemetry thresholds for automated fallback, manual rollback playbook with owner rotation and SLAs, UI/UX confirmation flows in Console for initiating rollbacks, audit logging requirements for legal/regulatory review, and test scenarios for canary->fallback->rollback.

Scope constraints: This ticket only covers the decision matrix and signoff criteria for Private (VPC + on-prem) multi-region rollbacks; it does not implement code nor update the runtime routing logic. Implementation tickets will be created under ENG once signoff is complete.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Cross-team acceptance matrix published in Confluence with explicit owners (Eng/Design/Legal/Security) and signed approvals by each owner.
A2: Telemetry thresholds documented (latency P95 > 800ms for 5m AND error rate > 3% for 3m triggers automated fallback) and reviewed by Reliability.
A3: Manual rollback playbook with step-by-step SOP, communication script, and on-call rotation assigned and accepted by Support/Oncall lead.
A4: Console UX wireframes showing UX flow for initiating a region fallback, confirmation modal text, and rollback progress state, reviewed by Design and PM.
A5: Legal confirms audit log schema and cross-border data movement language; signed note captured in PRD annex.

A6: Test matrix with 6 test scenarios (canary fail, latency spike, region capacity exhaustion, partial KV cache corruption, regulatory block, false-positive quick-recovery) validated by Eng and Reliability.
A7: Post-signoff runbook entry created in Ops-runbooks repository and linked in the PRD annex.
A8: Release checklist item created for private-2025.03 and dependency ENG implementation tickets scheduled.
deliverables: Signed PRD annex (Confluence) with decision matrix
Console UX wireframes and copy for rollback confirmation
Manual rollback SOP and oncall rota
Test scenario list and expected outcomes
Ops-runbooks entry and links to GH tests/PRs
